t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Alternate between the Gnomes to get higher amounts, when you get lower change what Gnome you choose.

vb_textbox.text: Alternate from left to right or right to left, if you start to get low scores like 0 or 1 change to the other gnome until you get higher numbers like 5 or 10, then alternate to the other Gnome.If you start getting lower numbers swap to the other gnome but remember keeping alternating gnomes this is crucial.Good Luck!
